application_date.description: Date the insurance application was submitted.
application_date.long-description: The calendar date on which the application for insurance coverage was completed and submitted to the insurer or producer.

cust_ref_id.long-description: A unique identifier or reference number assigned by the agency, broker, or customer for their internal tracking of this application or client.

policy_start_date.long-description: The desired or proposed date when the insurance policy is intended to become active and provide coverage.

policy_start_time.description: Proposed effective time of the policy.
policy_start_time.long-description: The specific time on the policy start date when the insurance coverage is intended to begin, usually in HH:MM format.

policy_end_date.long-description: The desired or proposed date when the insurance policy is intended to expire and coverage will cease, unless renewed.

name.long-description: The full legal name of the primary individual, company, or entity applying for and covered by the insurance policy.

address_1.description: First line of the insured's address.
address_1.long-description: The primary street address line for the insured's mailing or physical location.

address_2.description: Second line of the insured's address.
address_2.long-description: An optional secondary address line for the insured's mailing or physical location, often used for suite, apartment, or floor numbers.

city.long-description: The city component of the insured's mailing or physical address.

state.long-description: The state, province, or region component of the insured's mailing or physical address.

zipcode.description: Postal code of the insured's address.
zipcode.long-description: The postal code or ZIP code component of the insured's mailing or physical address.

pan_no.long-description: In India, the Permanent Account Number (PAN) is a ten-character alphanumeric identifier issued by the Indian Income Tax Department. It is mandatory for most financial transactions and tax purposes.

gstin.long-description: In India, the Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN) is a 15-character alphanumeric unique identification number provided to every taxpayer registered under the Goods and Services Tax regime.

udyam_reg_no.description: (IN) Udyam Registration No. (IRDAI mandatory for BSUS/BLUS), format UDYAM-XX-00-0000000
udyam_reg_no.long-description: In India, the Udyam Registration Number is a government-issued registration for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs). It's a unique identification and is often mandated by IRDAI for Business Small Underserved (BSUS) / Business Large Underserved (BLUS) segments in insurance.

cin.long-description: In India, the Corporate Identification Number (CIN) is a unique 21-digit alphanumeric code issued by the Registrar of Companies (ROC) to companies incorporated in India. It's used for tracking company activities.

llpin.long-description: In India, the Limited Liability Partnership Identification Number (LLPIN) is a unique 7-digit alphanumeric identifier assigned by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) to Limited Liability Partnerships.

industry_description.long-description: A concise summary of the primary business activities, trade, or occupation that the insured is engaged in, providing context for underwriting.

nic_code.long-description: In India, the National Industrial Classification (NIC) code, specifically from the 2008 revision, is a statistical standard used to classify economic activities. It helps in categorizing businesses based on their industry.

general_liability_code.long-description: A classification code used by insurers to categorize the general liability exposure of a business based on its operations and industry, influencing premium rates.

sic_code.long-description: The Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code is a four-digit numerical code used by government agencies to classify industry areas. It helps in categorizing businesses based on their primary activities.

naic_code.description: North American Industry Classification System code.
naic_code.long-description: The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is a six-digit numerical code used by government agencies to classify business establishments. It is the standard used by Federal statistical agencies in classifying business establishments for the purpose of collecting, analyzing, and publishing statistical data related to the U.S. business economy.

tax_code.description: Tax code, FEIN or SOC section number
tax_code.long-description: The tax identification number for the insured, which could be a Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) for businesses in the US, or another relevant tax section number as applicable to the jurisdiction.

phone_no.description: Primary phone number for the insured.
phone_no.long-description: The main telephone contact number for the insured entity.

website.long-description: The official website address (URL) of the insured's business or organization.

corporation.description: Indicates if the insured is a Corporation.
corporation.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the insured is legally structured as a corporation.

individual.description: Indicates if the insured is an Individual.
individual.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the insured is an individual person, typically a sole proprietor.

joint_venture.description: Indicates if the insured is a Joint Venture.
joint_venture.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the insured is a joint venture, which is a business arrangement in which two or more parties agree to pool their resources for the purpose of accomplishing a specific task.

llc.description: Indicates if the insured is a Limited Liability Company (LLC).
llc.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the insured is legally structured as a Limited Liability Company (LLC).

not_for_profit.description: Indicates if the insured is a Not-for-Profit organization.
not_for_profit.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the insured is legally recognized as a not-for-profit or non-profit organization.

partnership.description: Indicates if the insured is a Partnership.
partnership.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the insured is legally structured as a partnership.

subchapter_s_corp.description: Indicates if the insured is a Subchapter S Corporation.
subchapter_s_corp.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the insured is legally structured as a Subchapter S Corporation, a type of corporation that meets specific Internal Revenue Code requirements.

trust.description: Indicates if the insured is a Trust.
trust.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the insured is a trust, a legal arrangement where a trustee holds assets for the benefit of beneficiaries.

other.description: Indicates if the insured's legal entity type is Other.
other.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the insured's legal entity structure is not explicitly listed among the predefined options.

name.long-description: The full legal name of an additional individual, company, or entity also covered under this insurance policy, beyond the primary insured.

address_1.description: First line of the other insured's address.
address_1.long-description: The primary street address line for the additional insured's mailing or physical location.

address_2.description: Second line of the other insured's address.
address_2.long-description: An optional secondary address line for the additional insured's mailing or physical location.

city.description: City of the other insured's address.
city.long-description: The city component of the additional insured's mailing or physical address.

state.description: State of the other insured's address.
state.long-description: The state, province, or region component of the additional insured's mailing or physical address.

zipcode.description: Postal code of the other insured's address.
zipcode.long-description: The postal code or ZIP code component of the additional insured's mailing or physical address.

general_liability_code.long-description: A classification code used by insurers to categorize the general liability exposure of the other insured's business based on its operations and industry.

sic_code.description: Standard Industrial Classification code for the other insured.
sic_code.long-description: The Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code for the additional insured, categorizing their industry area.

naic_code.description: North American Industry Classification System code for the other insured.
naic_code.long-description: The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for the additional insured, classifying their business establishment.

tax_code.description: Tax code, FEIN or SOC section number
tax_code.long-description: The tax identification number for the other insured, such as a Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) or another relevant tax section number.

phone_no.description: Primary phone number for the other insured.
phone_no.long-description: The main telephone contact number for the additional insured entity.

website.description: Website URL for the other insured.
website.long-description: The official website address (URL) of the additional insured's business or organization.

corporation.description: Indicates if the other insured is a Corporation.
corporation.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether this additional insured is legally structured as a corporation.

individual.description: Indicates if the other insured is an Individual.
individual.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether this additional insured is an individual person, typically a sole proprietor.

joint_venture.description: Indicates if the other insured is a Joint Venture.
joint_venture.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether this additional insured is a joint venture.

llc.description: Indicates if the other insured is a Limited Liability Company (LLC).
llc.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether this additional insured is legally structured as a Limited Liability Company (LLC).

not_for_profit.description: Indicates if the other insured is a Not-for-Profit organization.
not_for_profit.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether this additional insured is legally recognized as a not-for-profit organization.

partnership.description: Indicates if the other insured is a Partnership.
partnership.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether this additional insured is legally structured as a partnership.

subchapter_s_corp.description: Indicates if the other insured is a Subchapter S Corporation.
subchapter_s_corp.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether this additional insured is legally structured as a Subchapter S Corporation.

trust.description: Indicates if the other insured is a Trust.
trust.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether this additional insured is a trust.

other.description: Indicates if the other insured's legal entity type is Other.
other.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether this additional insured's legal entity structure is not explicitly listed among the predefined options.

name.description: Name of the insurance producer (agent or broker).
name.long-description: The full name of the insurance agent or broker responsible for submitting this application.

phone_no.long-description: The primary telephone contact number for the insurance producer.

fax_no.long-description: The facsimile contact number for the insurance producer.

email.long-description: The primary email address for communication with the insurance producer.

code.long-description: A unique alphanumeric code assigned by the insurance carrier to identify the specific producer or agency.

sub_code.long-description: An optional secondary code used to identify a sub-agent or specific department within a larger producer agency.

license_no.description: Broker/agent license number assied by regulator
license_no.long-description: The unique license number issued to the insurance broker or agent by the relevant regulatory authority, allowing them to legally sell insurance.

line.description: Line of business for this license - property, liability, engineering, workers comp, life
line.long-description: Specifies the particular line of insurance business (e.g., property, casualty, life, health) that the producer's license is valid for.

jurisdiction.description: country (or state if USA) where is this valid
jurisdiction.long-description: The geographical area (country or US state) where the producer's license is legally recognized and valid for conducting insurance business.

valid_from.description: Start date of the license validity.
valid_from.long-description: The date from which the producer's insurance license became effective and legally valid.

valid_to.description: End date of the license validity.
valid_to.long-description: The date on which the producer's insurance license is set to expire, requiring renewal to remain valid.

accounts_receivables.description: Indicates if an Accounts Receivables schedule is attached.
accounts_receivables.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a separate schedule detailing the insured's accounts receivables is included with the application.

additional_interest_schedule.description: Indicates if an Additional Interest schedule is attached.
additional_interest_schedule.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a schedule listing all additional interested parties (e.g., mortgagees, loss payees) and their details is included with the application.

location_information.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a detailed schedule providing information about each insured premises or location is attached to the application.

appartment_supplement.description: Indicates if an Apartment Supplement is attached.
appartment_supplement.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a supplementary form specifically for apartment buildings or complexes is included with the application.

condo_bylaws.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the bylaws or governing documents of a condominium association are attached to the application, relevant for condo association policies.

contractors_supplement.description: Indicates if a Contractors Supplement is attached.
contractors_supplement.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a supplementary form specifically for contractors' operations and exposures is included with the application.

coverages_schedule.description: Indicates if a Coverages Schedule is attached.
coverages_schedule.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a detailed schedule outlining all selected coverages, limits, and deductibles is included with the application.

dealers_section.description: Indicates if a Dealers Section is attached.
dealers_section.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a specific section or form related to vehicle or equipment dealers' exposures is included with the application.

drivers_information.description: Indicates if Drivers Information is attached.
drivers_information.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a list of drivers and their details (e.g., license information, driving history) is included with the application, typically for auto or commercial vehicle policies.

eds_section.description: Indicates if an Equipment Dealers Supplement (EDS) is attached.
eds_section.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether an Equipment Dealers Supplement, providing specific details for businesses that sell or service equipment, is included with the application.

glass_signs.description: Indicates if a Glass & Signs schedule is attached.
glass_signs.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a separate schedule detailing insured glass and signs at the premises is included with the application.

hotel_motel_supplement.description: Indicates if a Hotel/Motel Supplement is attached.
hotel_motel_supplement.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a supplementary form specifically for hotel or motel operations and exposures is included with the application.

inst_builders_risk.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether an Installation/Builders Risk supplement, relevant for projects under construction or installation, is attached to the application.

intnl_liability.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a supplement detailing international liability exposures of the insured is attached to the application.

intnl_property.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a supplement detailing international property exposures of the insured is attached to the application.

loss_summary.description: Indicates if a Loss Summary is attached.
loss_summary.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a summary document outlining the insured's past loss history is included with the application.

open_cargo_section.description: Indicates if an Open Cargo Section is attached.
open_cargo_section.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a specific section or form related to open cargo insurance (for goods in transit) is included with the application.

premium_payment.description: Indicates if a Premium Payment schedule is attached.
premium_payment.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a schedule outlining the agreed-upon premium payment plan or installments is included with the application.

professional_liability.description: Indicates if a Professional Liability supplement is attached.
professional_liability.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a supplementary form specifically for professional liability exposures (Errors & Omissions) is included with the application.

restaurant_tavern.description: Indicates if a Restaurant/Tavern Supplement is attached.
restaurant_tavern.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a supplementary form specifically for restaurant or tavern operations and exposures is included with the application.

statement_schedule.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a Statement/Schedule of Values (SOV) is attached, detailing the values of insured property at various locations.

state_supplement.description: Indicates if a State Specific Supplement is attached.
state_supplement.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a supplementary form containing state-specific questions or requirements is included with the application.

vacant_building_supp.description: Indicates if a Vacant Building Supplement is attached.
vacant_building_supp.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a supplementary form for properties that are vacant or unoccupied is included with the application.

vehicle_schedule.description: Indicates if a Vehicle Schedule is attached.
vehicle_schedule.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a detailed schedule listing all insured vehicles is included with the application, typically for commercial auto policies.

other_attachment.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether any other type of attachment, not specifically listed, is included with the application.

location_id.long-description: A unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to differentiate individual physical locations where insured property or operations exist.

building_id.description: Unique identifier for the building at the location.
building_id.long-description: A unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to a specific building within a given location, especially if multiple buildings are present.

building_description.description: Description of the building at this location.
building_description.long-description: A brief textual description detailing the characteristics, purpose, or notable features of the building at the specified location.

address_1.description: First line of the location's address.
address_1.long-description: The primary street address line for the physical location of the insured property or operations.

address_2.description: Second line of the location's address.
address_2.long-description: An optional secondary address line for the location, often used for suite, apartment, or unit numbers.

city.long-description: The city component of the physical address of the insured location.

district.description: (IN) revenue district, used for STFI/earthquake zone determination
district.long-description: In India, the revenue district is an administrative division used for geographical classification, often crucial for determining Storm, Tempest, Flood, and Inundation (STFI) or earthquake zone ratings for insurance purposes.

county.long-description: The county or administrative division of the physical address of the insured location, common in US contexts.

state.long-description: The state, province, or region component of the physical address of the insured location.

zipcode.long-description: The postal code or ZIP code component of the physical address of the insured location.

pincode.long-description: In India, the Postal Index Number (PIN) code is a 6-digit number used by India Post to identify specific geographic regions, essential for mail delivery and location identification.

latitude.description: (IN) GPS latitude for catastrophe zone mapping
latitude.long-description: In India, the GPS latitude coordinate (decimal degrees) of the location, used to precisely map its position for assessing catastrophe zone risks like earthquakes or cyclones.

longitude.description: (IN) GPS longitude for catastrophe zone mapping
longitude.long-description: In India, the GPS longitude coordinate (decimal degrees) of the location, used to precisely map its position for assessing catastrophe zone risks like earthquakes or cyclones.

inside.description: Indicates if the location is inside city limits.
inside.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the physical location of the insured property or operations falls within the boundaries of an incorporated city or town.

outside.description: Indicates if the location is outside city limits.
outside.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the physical location of the insured property or operations is situated beyond the boundaries of an incorporated city or town.

nowhere.description: Indicates if city limits are not applicable or unknown for this location.
nowhere.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the concept of 'city limits' does not apply to this location (e.g., rural area) or the information is unavailable.

name.long-description: The full legal name of the insurance company providing the coverage.

naic_code.description: NAIC Company Code for the insurance carrier.
naic_code.long-description: The unique five-digit company code assigned by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) to identify the specific insurance carrier in the United States.

license_no.long-description: The official registration or license number issued to the insurance company by the relevant regulatory authority, permitting them to operate as an insurer.

product.long-description: A descriptive name or explanation of the specific insurance program or product being offered by the carrier (e.g., 'Commercial Package Policy', 'Small Business Fire Insurance').

product_code.long-description: An internal alphanumeric code used by the carrier to identify the specific insurance program or product being offered.

policy_no.description: Policy number assigned by the carrier.
policy_no.long-description: The unique identification number assigned by the insurance carrier to the specific policy issued to the insured.

underwriter.description: Name or ID of the underwriter at the carrier.
underwriter.long-description: The name or unique identifier of the underwriter at the insurance carrier responsible for evaluating and approving the risk.

branch_office.long-description: The specific branch office of the insurance carrier responsible for administering or issuing the policy.

year.description: Year the prior policy was effective.
year.long-description: The calendar year in which the previous insurance policy was in effect.

name.description: Name of the prior insurance carrier.
name.long-description: The full legal name of the insurance company that provided coverage to the insured in the prior policy period.

line.description: Line of business for this license - property, liability, engineering, workers comp, life
line.long-description: The specific line of business (e.g., property, liability) covered by the prior insurance policy.

policy_no.description: Policy number from the prior carrier.
policy_no.long-description: The unique identification number assigned by the previous insurance carrier to the prior policy.

premium.description: Premium paid for the prior policy.
premium.long-description: The total amount of premium paid for the prior insurance policy.

total_si.description: Total Sum Insured (SI) or Total Insured Value (TIV)
total_si.long-description: The aggregate sum insured or total insured value (TIV) across all coverages or locations under the prior policy.

start_date.description: Effective start date of the prior policy.
start_date.long-description: The date when the prior insurance policy became active and coverage began.

end_date.description: Expiry date of the prior policy.
end_date.long-description: The date when the prior insurance policy expired and coverage ceased.

no_prior_losses.description: Indicates if there were no prior losses reported.
no_prior_losses.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the insured has no record of prior insurance claims or losses for the specified period.

year_count.description: Number of prior years for which loss history is provided.
year_count.long-description: The total number of historical years for which loss data and claim history are being submitted or requested.

total_loss.description: Total amount of losses reported across all prior years.
total_loss.long-description: The cumulative monetary value of all reported claims and losses during the provided historical period.

year.long-description: The calendar year in which the specific loss event occurred.

lob.long-description: In India, the specific type of loss (e.g., fire, storm, earthquake, burglary) for which the claim was made.

line_of_business.description: Line of business for the reported loss (e.g., Property, Liability). (US)
line_of_business.long-description: The general category of insurance (e.g., Property, General Liability, Auto) under which the reported loss falls.

loss_details.long-description: A detailed explanation of the circumstances, cause, and impact of the reported loss event.

claim_date.long-description: The date on which the insurance claim for this specific loss was formally submitted to the insurer.

date_of_loss.long-description: In India, the precise date when the actual loss or damage event occurred.

claim_amount.long-description: In India, the total monetary amount of the claim as initially reported or estimated.

amount_paid.long-description: In India, the final monetary amount disbursed by the insurer to settle the claim.

amount_reserved.description: Amount reserved for the claim by the insurer.
amount_reserved.long-description: The monetary amount that the insurer has set aside or allocated to cover the potential payment of this claim.

subrogation.description: Indicates if subrogation applies to this claim (Y/N).
subrogation.long-description: A Y/N indicator specifying whether the insurer has the right to pursue a third party responsible for the loss to recover the amount paid on the claim.

claim_open.description: Indicates if the claim is still open (Y/N).
claim_open.long-description: A Y/N indicator specifying whether the claim is still actively being processed or investigated, or if it has been closed.

settled.long-description: In India, a boolean flag indicating that the claim has been fully resolved and the payment has been made.

pending.long-description: In India, a boolean flag indicating that the claim is currently under review, investigation, or awaiting resolution.

repudiated.long-description: In India, a boolean flag indicating that the claim has been denied by the insurer, meaning no payment will be made.

income_expenses_form_attached.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether the ACORD 810 form, which details income and expenses for business interruption coverage, is attached to the application.

value_report_form_attached.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether the ACORD 811 form, used for reporting fluctuating values of inventory or other property, is attached to the application.

location_id.long-description: A unique identifier linking this specific property premises information to a broader location definition listed in the 'location' section.

owner.description: Indicates if the insured is the owner of the premises.
owner.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the insured holds the legal title and ownership of the property premises.

tenant.description: Indicates if the insured is a tenant of the premises.
tenant.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the insured occupies the property premises under a lease agreement, without holding ownership.

other.description: Indicates if the insured has another interest in the premises.
other.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the insured has a legal or financial interest in the property premises that is neither full ownership nor a tenancy.

industrial.long-description: In India, a boolean flag indicating that the risk location is primarily used for industrial activities such as manufacturing or heavy processing.

non_industrial.description: (IN) Primarily used for non-industrial purposes (e.g., commercial, retail).
non_industrial.long-description: In India, a boolean flag indicating that the risk location is used for non-industrial purposes, such as commercial offices, retail, or residential.

mixed.description: (IN) Has a combination of industrial and non-industrial uses.
mixed.long-description: In India, a boolean flag indicating that the risk location has a combination of industrial and non-industrial uses.

description.description: (US) e.g. Building, Business Personal Property, Business Income, EDP Equipment, Signs
description.long-description: (US) A specific item or category of property being insured, such as the physical building, business contents, loss of income, electronic data processing equipment, or exterior signs.

limit_amount.description: (US) limit of insurance for this subject
limit_amount.long-description: (US) The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for loss or damage to this specific subject of insurance.

co_insurance_percent.description: (US) coinsurance percentage, e.g. 80, 90, 100; (IN) average clause percentage; underinsurance waiver up to 15% applies for BSUS/BLUS
co_insurance_percent.long-description: (US) (IN) The percentage of the property's total value that the insured is required to carry as coverage; if less is carried, the insured may be penalized in case of a partial loss. In India, this is referred to as the average clause percentage, with specific waivers for BSUS/BLUS.

actual_cash_value.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that loss settlement will be based on the replacement cost less depreciation, considering age and wear and tear.

replacement_cost.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that loss settlement will be based on the cost to replace the damaged property with new property of similar kind and quality, without deduction for depreciation.

functional_rc.description: (US) Loss settlement based on functionally equivalent replacement cost.
functional_rc.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that loss settlement will be based on the cost to repair or replace the damaged property with less costly, but functionally equivalent, materials or property.

selling_price.description: (US) Loss settlement for finished goods at selling price.
selling_price.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that loss settlement for finished goods will be based on their selling price, including any profit that would have been earned.

agreed_value.description: (US) Loss settlement based on a pre-agreed property value.
agreed_value.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the insurer and insured have agreed upon a specific value for the property prior to any loss, which will be the basis for settlement.

market_value.description: (IN) MV - new replacement cost minus depreciation
market_value.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that loss settlement will be based on the current market value of the property, which is typically its new replacement cost minus depreciation.

reinstatement_value.description: (IN) RIV / RRC - new replacement cost, no depreciation deduction
reinstatement_value.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that loss settlement will be based on the Reinstatement Value (RIV) or Replacement Cost (RRC), covering the cost of new replacement without any deduction for depreciation.

book_value.description: (IN) Loss settlement based on asset's book value.
book_value.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that loss settlement will be based on the value of the asset as recorded in the insured's accounting books (original cost minus accumulated depreciation).

landed_cost.description: (IN) for raw material - landed cost at premises
landed_cost.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that for raw materials, loss settlement will be based on the total cost of materials delivered to the premises, including purchase price, freight, and duties.

other.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that another valuation method, not specifically listed, will be used for loss settlement.

building_structure.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the insured asset is the physical building structure itself, including its plinth, foundation, and surrounding compound walls.

plant_machinery.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the insured assets are the plant and machinery, including their purchase cost, freight, and installation expenses.

stock_raw_material.description: (IN) Is the stock a raw material
stock_raw_material.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the insured asset is stock in the form of raw materials used in production.

stock_in_process.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the insured asset is stock that is currently undergoing manufacturing or processing.

stock_finished_goods.description: (IN) Is stock in the form of finished goods
stock_finished_goods.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the insured asset is stock in the form of finished products ready for sale.

stock_packing_material.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the insured asset is stock consisting of materials used for packaging finished goods.

furniture_fixtures_fittings.description: (IN) Insured asset includes furniture, fixtures, and fittings.
furniture_fixtures_fittings.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the insured assets include furniture, fixtures (e.g., lighting), and fittings (e.g., plumbing) within the premises.

electronic_data_processing.description: (IN) Insured asset includes electronic data processing equipment.
electronic_data_processing.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the insured assets include electronic data processing equipment, such as computers, servers, and related peripherals.

specific_contents.description: (IN) bullion, manuscripts, securities, explosives - must be separately declared
specific_contents.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that highly valuable or hazardous contents (e.g., bullion, manuscripts, securities, explosives) are being insured, which typically require separate and specific declaration.

other_contents.description: (IN) Insured asset includes other general contents.
other_contents.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that other general contents not falling into specific categories are being insured.

specific.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the stock is insured for a fixed sum, regardless of fluctuations in its value or quantity.

declaration.description: (IN) monthly declaration policy for fluctuating stocks
declaration.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the stock is insured under a declaration policy, where the insured reports stock values periodically (e.g., monthly), and premium is adjusted based on average values.

floater.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the stock is covered under a floater policy, which provides coverage for property that is moved between multiple specified locations, with a single Sum Insured.

declaration_policy_minimum_si.long-description: (IN) For a declaration policy, this is the minimum or deposit sum insured agreed upon, which forms the basis for initial premium calculation, subject to adjustment based on later declarations.

basic.description: (US) Coverage for a defined list of basic perils.
basic.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that coverage is provided for a defined list of perils, typically including fire, lightning, explosion, windstorm, hail, smoke, aircraft/vehicle damage, riot, civil commotion, and vandalism.

broad.description: (US) Coverage for basic perils plus additional causes (e.g., falling objects, water damage).
broad.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that coverage extends beyond basic perils to include additional causes of loss like falling objects, weight of snow/ice/sleet, water damage (from accidental discharge/overflow).

special.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that coverage is provided for all causes of direct physical loss or damage, except for those specifically excluded by the policy.

special_incl_theft.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that 'special' cause of loss coverage is chosen and explicitly includes coverage for losses due to theft.

special_excl_theft.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that 'special' cause of loss coverage is chosen but explicitly excludes coverage for losses due to theft.

earthquake.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating specific coverage for losses caused by earthquake, typically added as an endorsement or separate policy.

flood.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating specific coverage for losses caused by flood, typically added as an endorsement or separate policy.

windstorm_hail.description: (US) Specific coverage for windstorm and hail losses.
windstorm_hail.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating specific coverage for losses caused by windstorm and hail, often subject to a separate deductible.

other.description: (US) Indicates other non-listed causes of loss are covered.
other.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that other specific causes of loss, not listed, are covered.

inflation_guard_percent.description: (US) Annual percentage to increase coverage for inflation.
inflation_guard_percent.long-description: (US) A percentage applied annually to automatically increase the coverage limit to account for inflation, helping to prevent underinsurance over time.

deductible.description: (US); (IN) compulsory excess in INR; BSUS/BLUS: higher of ₹10,000 or 5% of claim
deductible.long-description: (US) (IN) The initial amount of a loss that the insured must bear before the insurance coverage begins to pay. In India, this is often referred to as compulsory excess, with specific rules for BSUS/BLUS policies.

deductible_type.description: (US) The specific type of deductible applied (e.g., per occurrence, aggregate).
deductible_type.long-description: (US) The type of deductible applied, e.g., per occurrence, aggregate, percentage deductible, or named peril deductible.

blanket_no.description: (US) Reference number for blanket policy coverage.
blanket_no.long-description: (US) A unique reference number if this subject of insurance is covered under a blanket policy, meaning one limit applies to multiple items or locations.

forms.long-description: (US) A descriptive list or reference codes for the specific insurance forms and conditions that are applicable to this subject of insurance.

zone_ii.description: (IN) BIS IS:1893 seismic zone II - low damage risk
zone_ii.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the location falls under BIS IS:1893 seismic zone II, signifying a low damage risk from earthquakes.

zone_iii.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the location falls under BIS IS:1893 seismic zone III, signifying a moderate damage risk from earthquakes.

zone_iv.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the location falls under BIS IS:1893 seismic zone IV, signifying a high damage risk from earthquakes.

zone_v.description: (IN) very high damage risk e.g. parts of J&K, NE states, Gujarat, Uttarakhand
zone_v.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the location falls under BIS IS:1893 seismic zone V, signifying a very high damage risk from earthquakes, common in regions like Jammu & Kashmir, Northeastern states, Gujarat, and Uttarakhand.

cyclone_prone_coast.description: (IN) Bay of Bengal or Arabian Sea coastal belt
cyclone_prone_coast.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating whether the location is situated within a coastal belt that is susceptible to cyclones originating from the Bay of Bengal or Arabian Sea.

flood_zone.description: (IN) located in designated flood plain or flood-prone district
flood_zone.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating whether the location is situated within a designated flood plain or a district officially identified as prone to flooding.

zone_a.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the location is in Zone A, which carries the highest rating for Storm, Tempest, Flood, and Inundation (STFI) perils.

zone_b.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the location is in Zone B for STFI perils, representing a moderate rating.

zone_c.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the location is in Zone C for STFI perils, representing the lowest rating.

fire.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by fire, including fire resulting from fermentation or spontaneous combustion, as part of the Fire and Allied Perils (FLEXA) coverage.

lightning.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by lightning, as part of the Fire and Allied Perils (FLEXA) coverage.

explosion_implosion.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by explosion or implosion, specifically from items like boilers, gas cylinders, etc., as part of the Fire and Allied Perils (FLEXA) coverage.

aircraft_damage.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by impact from aircraft or other aerial devices, as part of the Fire and Allied Perils (FLEXA) coverage.

riot_strike_malicious_damage.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by riot, strike, and malicious damage (RSMD).

storm_tempest_flood_inundation.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by storm, tempest, flood, and inundation (STFI).

impact_damage.description: (IN) by road/rail vehicle or animal - third party
impact_damage.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by impact from external third-party road or rail vehicles or animals.

subsidence_landslide.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by subsidence (sinking of ground) or landslide, including rockslides.

bursting_overflowing_water_tanks.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by the bursting or overflowing of water tanks, apparatus, or pipes.

missile_testing.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by missile testing operations.

leakage_sprinkler.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by accidental leakage from automatic sprinkler systems.

bush_fire.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by bush fire, forest fire, or jungle fire.

earthquake.description: (IN) inbuilt under BSUS/BLUS; optional add-on under SFSP
earthquake.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by earthquake. This is an inbuilt peril for Business Small Underserved (BSUS) and Business Large Underserved (BLUS) policies, but an optional add-on for Standard Fire and Special Perils (SFSP) policies.

terrorism.description: (IN) covered via India Market Terrorism Risk Insurance Pool (IMTRIP)
terrorism.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating coverage for loss or damage caused by acts of terrorism, which is typically provided through the India Market Terrorism Risk Insurance Pool (IMTRIP).

stfi_deleted.description: (IN) STFI perils deleted at inception for premium discount (SFSP only)
stfi_deleted.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating whether the Storm, Tempest, Flood, and Inundation (STFI) perils have been explicitly removed from coverage at the policy's inception, usually resulting in a premium discount (applicable only for Standard Fire and Special Perils policies).

rsmtd_deleted.description: (IN) RSMD/RSMTD deleted at inception for premium discount (SFSP only)
rsmtd_deleted.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating whether the Riot, Strike, Malicious Damage (RSMD) or Riot, Strike, Malicious Damage, Terrorism, Sabotage (RSMTD) perils have been explicitly removed from coverage at the policy's inception, usually resulting in a premium discount (applicable only for Standard Fire and Special Perils policies).

opted.description: Indicates if spoilage coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether coverage for loss due to spoilage of perishable goods is included in the policy.

description.description: Description of items covered under spoilage.
description.long-description: A detailed explanation of the specific types of perishable goods or products that are protected by the spoilage coverage.

limit.description: Limit of insurance for spoilage coverage.
limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for losses related to spoilage.

deductible.long-description: The amount the insured must pay out-of-pocket for each spoilage claim before the insurance coverage applies.

refrigeration_agreement.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether a formal maintenance agreement is in place for all refrigeration equipment, which can be a condition for spoilage coverage.

breakdown.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether spoilage coverage includes losses resulting from mechanical breakdown of refrigeration equipment or contamination.

power_outage.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether spoilage losses caused by an interruption of electrical power are covered under the policy.

selling_price.description: loss settlement at sale price or cost price?
selling_price.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the loss settlement for spoilage will be based on the selling price (including anticipated profit) or the cost price of the spoiled goods.

opted.description: Indicates if sinkhole coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether coverage for loss or damage caused by sinkholes is included in the policy.

limit.description: Limit of insurance for sinkhole coverage.
limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for losses related to sinkholes.

opted.description: Indicates if mine subsidence coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether coverage for loss or damage caused by subsidence of land due to underground mining operations is included.

limit.description: Limit of insurance for mine subsidence coverage.
limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for losses related to mine subsidence.

opted.description: Indicates if Business Income coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether coverage for loss of income due to suspension of operations caused by covered perils is included in the policy.

period_of_indemnity_days.description: maximum period of restoration in days
period_of_indemnity_days.long-description: The maximum number of days for which business income loss will be paid, representing the expected time to restore operations after a covered loss.

coinsurance_pct.long-description: The percentage of the insured's annual business income that must be carried as coverage; failure to meet this can result in a penalty at the time of loss.

agreed_value.description: Indicates if agreed value option is selected for business income.
agreed_value.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the insurer and insured have agreed upon a specific business income value in advance, waiving the coinsurance clause.

extended_period_days.description: Number of days for extended period of indemnity.
extended_period_days.long-description: The additional number of days after the period of restoration (or policy expiry) for which business income coverage continues, to allow the business to return to its pre-loss operational level.

opted.description: Indicates if Extra Expense coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether coverage for necessary expenses incurred to minimize business interruption or continue operations after a loss is included.

limit.description: Limit of insurance for Extra Expense coverage.
limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for extra expenses incurred to continue operations after a covered loss.

opted.description: Indicates if Ordinance or Law coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether coverage for additional costs incurred due to enforcement of building codes or ordinances after a covered loss is included.

coverage_a_limit.long-description: The limit of insurance under Coverage A for Ordinance or Law, covering the loss of value to the undamaged portion of a building that must be demolished or repaired due to code enforcement.

coverage_b_limit.long-description: The limit of insurance under Coverage B for Ordinance or Law, covering the cost to demolish the undamaged portion of a building required by code after a covered loss.

coverage_c_limit.long-description: The limit of insurance under Coverage C for Ordinance or Law, covering the increased cost to reconstruct or repair a building to comply with current building codes after a covered loss.

opted.description: Indicates if Inland Marine coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether coverage for property in transit, property of others in the insured's care, or specialized property (e.g., fine art, contractor's equipment) is included.

description.description: Description of property covered under Inland Marine.
description.long-description: A textual description detailing the specific types of property or situations covered under the Inland Marine section of the policy.

limit.description: Limit of insurance for Inland Marine coverage.
limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for losses covered under the Inland Marine section.

opted.description: Indicates if Equipment Breakdown coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether coverage for sudden and accidental breakdown of machinery and equipment (e.g., boilers, electrical systems, air conditioning) is included.

limit.description: Limit of insurance for Equipment Breakdown coverage.
limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for losses related to equipment breakdown.

opted.description: Indicates if Accounts Receivable coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether coverage for losses incurred when accounts receivable records are damaged or destroyed by a covered peril, making them uncollectible, is included.

limit.description: Limit of insurance for Accounts Receivable coverage.
limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for losses related to damaged or destroyed accounts receivable records.

opted.description: Indicates if Valuable Papers and Records coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether coverage for the cost to replace or restore valuable papers and records (e.g., maps, blueprints, financial records) damaged by a covered peril is included.

limit.description: Limit of insurance for Valuable Papers and Records coverage.
limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for losses related to valuable papers and records.

opted.description: Indicates if Electronic Data Processing (EDP) coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether specialized coverage for computer hardware, software, and data, including risks like power surges, mechanical breakdown, and virus attacks, is included.

hardware_limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for physical loss or damage to Electronic Data Processing (EDP) hardware.

software_limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for loss or damage to Electronic Data Processing (EDP) software and data.

extra_expense_limit.description: Limit for extra expense related to EDP.
extra_expense_limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for extra expenses incurred to restore or continue EDP operations after a covered loss.

opted.description: Indicates if Earthquake coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether specific coverage for losses caused by earthquake and related perils (e.g., volcanic eruption, landslide) is included.

limit.description: Limit of insurance for Earthquake coverage.
limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for losses caused by earthquakes.

deductible_pct.long-description: The deductible for earthquake claims expressed as a percentage of the total insured value or loss, rather than a fixed monetary amount.

opted.description: Indicates if Flood coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether specific coverage for losses caused by flood (inundation of normally dry land by water) is included.

limit.description: Limit of insurance for Flood coverage.
limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for losses caused by flood.

deductible.long-description: The amount the insured must pay out-of-pocket for each flood claim before the insurance coverage applies.

nfip_policy_no.description: National Flood Insurance Program policy number if applicable
nfip_policy_no.long-description: The policy number if the flood coverage is provided through the US National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP), which is government-backed.

opted.description: Indicates if Windstorm and Hail coverage is opted for.
opted.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether specific coverage for losses caused by windstorms and hail is included.

limit.description: Limit of insurance for Windstorm and Hail coverage.
limit.long-description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for losses caused by windstorm and hail.

deductible_pct.description: Deductible percentage for windstorm and hail claims.
deductible_pct.long-description: The deductible for windstorm and hail claims expressed as a percentage of the total insured value or loss, rather than a fixed monetary amount.

opted.description: (IN) Are hazardous/flammable goods stored?
opted.long-description: (IN) A Y/N indicator whether hazardous or flammable goods are stored at the premises.

description.description: (IN) nature of hazardous/flammable goods stored
description.long-description: (IN) A detailed description of the type, quantity, and storage methods for any hazardous or flammable goods kept at the premises.

class_a.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that petroleum products with a flash point below 23°C (e.g., petrol) are stored, representing the highest fire risk.

class_b.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that petroleum products with a flash point between 23°C and 65°C (e.g., kerosene) are stored.

class_c.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that petroleum products with a flash point above 65°C (e.g., diesel) are stored, representing a lower fire risk compared to Class A and B.

quantity_litres.description: (IN) Quantity of hazardous/flammable liquids in litres.
quantity_litres.long-description: (IN) The total quantity of hazardous or flammable liquids stored at the premises, measured in litres.

opted.description: (IN) Are LPG/CNG cylinders/installations present?
opted.long-description: (IN) A Y/N indicator whether LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) or CNG (Compressed Natural Gas) cylinders or installations are present at the premises.

cylinder_count.long-description: (IN) The total number of LPG or CNG cylinders installed or stored at the premises.

basement_used_for_storage.description: (IN) Is the basement used for storage?
basement_used_for_storage.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating whether the basement of the building is utilized for storage purposes, which can impact fire risk.

night_watchman.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating whether a night watchman is employed to provide security and fire vigilance during non-business hours.

opted.description: (IN) Any past fire incidents?
opted.long-description: (IN) A Y/N indicator whether the premises has experienced any fire incidents in the past.

description.description: (IN) Description of past fire incident.
description.long-description: (IN) A detailed description of any past fire incidents, including dates, causes, and extent of damage.

other_coverages_description.description: Description of any other property coverages not explicitly listed.
other_coverages_description.long-description: An open text field to specify any additional or unique property coverages that are not categorized by the predefined options.

full_time_emp_count.description: Number of full-time employees at this location.
full_time_emp_count.long-description: The total count of full-time employees regularly working at this specific premises.

part_time_emp_count.description: Number of part-time employees at this location.
part_time_emp_count.long-description: The total count of part-time employees regularly working at this specific premises.

annual_revenue.description: Annual revenue generated at this location.
annual_revenue.long-description: The total monetary income generated by the business operations at this specific premises within a year.

area_sqft.long-description: The total square footage of the area at the premises that is actively occupied or utilized by the insured.

public_area_sqft.description: Square footage of areas accessible to the public.
public_area_sqft.long-description: The total square footage of the premises that is regularly accessible to customers, clients, or the general public.

total_area_sqft.description: Total square footage of the premises.
total_area_sqft.long-description: The overall total square footage of the entire property premises, including occupied and unoccupied areas.

description.description: General description of the premises and its operations.
description.long-description: A comprehensive textual description detailing the physical characteristics, type of operations, and overall usage of the insured premises.

sub_leased.description: Indicates if any part of the premises is sub-leased (Y/N).
sub_leased.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether any portion of the insured premises is currently sub-leased to another entity or individual.

occupancy.description: (US, IN) described use/occupancy of the building
occupancy.long-description: A description of the primary use or occupancy of the building, such as 'Retail Store', 'Office Building', 'Manufacturing Plant', 'Residential Dwelling', etc. (US, IN).

tariff_occupancy_code.description: (IN) AIFT 2001 occupancy code e.g. II(a), III(b)
tariff_occupancy_code.long-description: (IN) The specific occupancy code from the All India Fire Tariff (AIFT) 2001, used to classify the building's use for fire insurance rating purposes, e.g., 'II(a)' for certain commercial risks or 'III(b)' for industrial risks.

historical_landmark.description: (US) Is the building a historical landmark?
historical_landmark.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether the building is designated as a historical landmark, which may affect repair or replacement options after a loss.

open_sides_count.description: (US) number of open/exposed sides on structure
open_sides_count.long-description: (US) The number of sides of the building structure that are open or exposed to external elements or adjacent properties, influencing windstorm and fire exposure ratings.

frame.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating Type 1 construction where the exterior walls are wood or other combustible materials.

joisted_masonry.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating Type 2 construction where exterior walls are masonry, but floors and roof are combustible (joisted wood or other similar materials).

non_combustible.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating Type 3 construction where exterior walls, floor, and roof are all non-combustible materials, but the roof and floor assembly are not fire-resistive.

masonry_non_combustible.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating Type 4 construction where exterior walls are masonry, and the interior structural members (floors/roof) are non-combustible.

modified_fire_resistive.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating Type 5 construction where structural components have a fire-resistive rating of 1 to 2 hours.

fire_resistive.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating Type 6 construction where structural components have a fire-resistive rating of 2 hours or more, providing the highest level of fire protection.

pucca_rcc.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating 'Pucca' construction with Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) structure, considered fire-resistive and classified as AIFT Class 1, offering the lowest fire risk.

pucca_non_rcc.description: (IN) brick/stone masonry with RCC/AC/GI roof - AIFT Class 2
pucca_non_rcc.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating 'Pucca' construction with brick or stone masonry walls and a roof made of RCC, Asbestos Cement (AC) sheets, or Galvanized Iron (GI) sheets, classified as AIFT Class 2.

semi_pucca.description: (IN) kutcha walls or kutcha roof - AIFT Class 3
semi_pucca.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating 'Semi-Pucca' construction where either the walls or the roof are made of temporary or easily combustible 'kutcha' materials, classified as AIFT Class 3.

kutcha.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating 'Kutcha' construction where all structural components (walls and roof) are made of temporary or easily combustible materials (e.g., thatch, mud), classified as AIFT Class 4, representing the highest fire tariff.

prefabricated_steel.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the building is constructed using prefabricated steel components.

other.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the building's construction type is not among the specified options.

aift_construction_class.long-description: (IN) The specific construction class (1 to 4) as per the All India Fire Tariff (AIFT) 2001, which categorizes buildings based on their fire-resisting properties and materials used.

roof_material.description: (IN) e.g. RCC, AC Sheet, GI Sheet, Thatch/Grass
roof_material.long-description: (IN) The primary material used for the roof of the building, such as Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC), Asbestos Cement (AC) sheets, Galvanized Iron (GI) sheets, or highly combustible materials like thatch or grass.

wall_material.long-description: (IN) The primary material used for the exterior walls of the building, such as brick, stone, wood, or mud.

distance_to_hydrant.long-description: (US) The measured distance in feet from the insured building to the nearest fire hydrant, impacting the public fire protection grading.

distance_to_fire_station.long-description: (US) The measured distance in miles from the insured building to the nearest fire station, impacting the public fire protection grading.

distance_to_fire_station_km.long-description: (IN) The measured distance in kilometres from the insured building to the nearest operational fire station, a factor in fire risk assessment.

municipal_professional.description: (IN) Served by professional municipal fire brigade.
municipal_professional.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the location is served by a professional municipal fire brigade, offering generally good fire protection.

industrial_brigade.description: (IN) Has access to a dedicated industrial fire brigade.
industrial_brigade.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the location has access to a dedicated industrial fire brigade, typically found in large industrial complexes.

voluntary.description: (IN) Served by a voluntary fire brigade.
voluntary.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the location is served by a voluntary fire brigade, which may have limited resources or response times.

no_brigade.description: (IN) No access to a formal fire brigade.
no_brigade.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the location has no access to a formal fire brigade, implying higher fire risk.

fire_district.description: (US) The specific fire district of the property.
fire_district.long-description: (US) The specific fire district or protection area where the insured property is located, determined by local fire departments.

fire_district_code.description: (US) ISO or local authority fire district code number like 03A, NYC-7, Rural-2
fire_district_code.long-description: (US) The alphanumeric code assigned by the ISO (Insurance Services Office) or local authority to identify a specific fire protection district, used for rating purposes.

protection_class.long-description: (US) The ISO Public Protection Classification (PPC) number (1-10) assigned to a community's fire protection capabilities, with Class 1 being the best and Class 10 having little or no fire protection.

stories_count.long-description: (US) The total number of above-ground stories or floors in the insured building.

basement_count.description: (US) number of basement levels below ground
basement_count.long-description: (US) The total number of subterranean levels or basements in the insured building.

year_built.description: (US) Year the building was originally constructed.
year_built.long-description: (US) The calendar year in which the insured building was originally constructed.

occupied_area_sqft.long-description: (US) The total square footage of the building that is actively used or occupied by the insured's operations.

roofing_type.long-description: (US) The specific type of material used for the roof covering (e.g., asphalt shingles, metal, built-up, tile), which impacts wind and fire resistance.

heating_type.description: (US) Primary heating method or fuel type.
heating_type.long-description: (US) The primary method or fuel used for heating the building (e.g., natural gas, electric, oil, forced air, radiant).

under_construction.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating whether the building is currently under construction, renovation, or erection, relevant for Builders' Risk policies.

construction_completion_date.description: (IN) expected completion date if under construction
construction_completion_date.long-description: (IN) The anticipated date when the construction or renovation project is expected to be finalized, if the building is currently under construction.

wiring_year_updated.description: (US) Year electrical wiring was last updated.
wiring_year_updated.long-description: (US) The most recent year when the building's electrical wiring system was updated or replaced.

plumbing_year_updated.description: (US) Year plumbing system was last updated.
plumbing_year_updated.long-description: (US) The most recent year when the building's plumbing system was updated or replaced.

roof_year_updated.description: (US) Year roof covering was last updated.
roof_year_updated.long-description: (US) The most recent year when the building's roof covering was updated or replaced.

heating_year_updated.description: (US) Year heating system was last updated.
heating_year_updated.long-description: (US) The most recent year when the building's heating system was updated or replaced.

building_code_grade.description: (US) ISO or local building code compliance grade
building_code_grade.long-description: (US) The grade or classification assigned by ISO (Building Code Effectiveness Grading Schedule - BCEGS) or a local authority, indicating the effectiveness of building codes and their enforcement, which impacts property risk.

tax_code.long-description: (US) The unique identifier assigned by the local tax assessor's office to the property for taxation purposes.

roof_type.description: (US) roof material e.g. asphalt shingle, metal, built-up, tile
roof_type.long-description: (US) The specific type of material and construction method used for the roof, providing details beyond just the material, for example, 'flat built-up roof' or 'gable asphalt shingle'.

resistive.description: (US) Building has features to resist high winds.
resistive.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the building construction incorporates features designed to resist high winds, such as reinforced roofing or window protection.

semi_resistive.description: (US) Building has some wind resistance features.
semi_resistive.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the building construction has some features for wind resistance, but not to the extent of a fully resistive structure.

opted.description: (US) includes wood stoves and fireplaces
opted.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether the premises utilizes wood-burning heat sources, such as wood stoves or fireplaces.

manufacturer.long-description: (US) The manufacturer of the wood-burning appliance installed at the premises.

date_installed.long-description: (US) The date when the wood-burning appliance was installed.

opted.description: (US) Boiler is the primary heating source.
opted.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that a boiler is the primary heating source.

insured.description: (US) Is the primary boiler specifically insured?
insured.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether the primary boiler is specifically insured under the policy (e.g., via equipment breakdown coverage).

opted.description: (US) Solid fuel system is the primary heating source.
opted.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that a solid fuel (e.g., coal, pellets) system is the primary heating source.

opted.description: (US) Other unlisted primary heating system.
opted.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that an 'other' heating system, not explicitly listed, is the primary heating source.

description.description: (US) Description of the primary 'other' heating system.
description.long-description: (US) A description of the primary 'other' heating system in use.

opted.description: (US) Boiler is the secondary heating source.
opted.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that a boiler serves as a secondary heating source.

insured.description: (US) Is the secondary boiler specifically insured?
insured.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether the secondary boiler is specifically insured under the policy.

opted.description: (US) Solid fuel system is the secondary heating source.
opted.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that a solid fuel system is a secondary heating source.

opted.description: (US) Other unlisted secondary heating system.
opted.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that an 'other' heating system, not explicitly listed, is a secondary heating source.

description.description: (US) Description of the secondary 'other' heating system.
description.long-description: (US) A description of the secondary 'other' heating system in use.

exposure.description: (US) description of adjacent structure or open space e.g. masonry commercial, vacant lot, street
exposure.long-description: (US) A textual description of what is located directly in front of the insured building, such as an adjacent commercial building, an empty plot of land, or a street.

distance.description: (US) distance in feet to adjacent exposure e.g. 10 ft, attached, 50 ft
distance.long-description: (US) The measured distance in feet from the front of the insured building to the nearest adjacent exposure, or 'attached' if it shares a wall.

exposure.description: (US) description of adjacent structure or open space
exposure.long-description: (US) A textual description of what is located directly behind the insured building, such as an adjacent commercial building, a parking lot, or an alley.

distance.description: (US) distance in feet to adjacent exposure
distance.long-description: (US) The measured distance in feet from the rear of the insured building to the nearest adjacent exposure.

exposure.description: (US) description of adjacent structure or open space
exposure.long-description: (US) A textual description of what is located directly to the left side of the insured building (when facing the front).

distance.description: (US) distance in feet to adjacent exposure
distance.long-description: (US) The measured distance in feet from the left side of the insured building to the nearest adjacent exposure.

exposure.description: (US) description of adjacent structure or open space
exposure.long-description: (US) A textual description of what is located directly to the right side of the insured building (when facing the front).

distance.description: (US) distance in feet to adjacent exposure
distance.long-description: (US) The measured distance in feet from the right side of the insured building to the nearest adjacent exposure.

alarm_type.description: (US) type of burglar alarm e.g. motion sensor, door contact, dual tech
alarm_type.long-description: (US) The specific type of burglar alarm system installed, detailing the detection technology used, e.g., motion sensors, door/window contacts, or dual technology sensors.

certificate_no.long-description: (US) The unique certificate number issued for the alarm system, usually by a central monitoring station or an accredited alarm installer.

certificate_expiry.description: (US) Expiration date of alarm monitoring certificate.
certificate_expiry.long-description: (US) The expiration date of the burglar alarm system's monitoring certificate.

central.description: (US) monitored by UL listed central station
central.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the burglar alarm system is connected to and monitored by a UL (Underwriters Laboratories) listed central monitoring station, which provides higher security.

local.description: (US) local gong audible alarm only, no monitoring
local.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the burglar alarm system only produces an audible alarm on-site (local gong) and is not connected to a remote monitoring service.

central_station_has_keys.description: (US) central station has keys to premises
central_station_has_keys.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether the central alarm monitoring station holds keys or has access codes to the insured premises for emergency response.

installed_serviced_by.description: (US) company that installed and services the alarm
installed_serviced_by.long-description: (US) The name of the company responsible for both the initial installation and ongoing maintenance and servicing of the burglar alarm system.

extent.description: (US) coverage extent e.g. full, partial, perimeter only
extent.long-description: (US) The scope or reach of the burglar alarm system's protection, e.g., covering the 'full' interior, 'partial' areas, or only the 'perimeter' of the building.

grade.description: (US) alarm system grade/quality rating e.g. A, B, UL certified
grade.long-description: (US) The official grade or quality rating assigned to the alarm system, indicating its reliability and compliance with industry standards (e.g., Grade A, UL Certified).

guards_watchmen_count.description: (US) number of security guards or watchmen on premises
guards_watchmen_count.long-description: (US) The total number of security personnel or watchmen actively present and patrolling the premises.

clock_hourly.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether security guards or watchmen conduct documented hourly rounds using a clocking system to ensure vigilance.

description.description: (US) fire suppression systems installed e.g. sprinklers, standpipes, CO2, chemical systems
description.long-description: (US) A detailed description of the fire suppression systems installed in the building, such as automatic sprinklers, standpipe systems, CO2 systems, or various chemical suppression systems.

sprinkler_percent.description: (US) percentage of premises covered by sprinklers 0-100
sprinkler_percent.long-description: (US) The percentage of the total floor area of the premises that is protected by an automatic fire sprinkler system (0-100%).

alarm_manufacturer.description: (US) fire alarm system manufacturer e.g. Honeywell, Simplex, Notifier
alarm_manufacturer.long-description: (US) The brand or company that manufactured the installed fire alarm system (e.g., Honeywell, Simplex, Notifier).

central.description: (US) fire alarm monitored by UL listed central station
central.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the fire alarm system is connected to and monitored by a UL (Underwriters Laboratories) listed central monitoring station.

local.description: (US) local gong audible alarm only, no monitoring
local.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the fire alarm system only produces an audible alarm on-site (local gong) and is not connected to a remote monitoring service.

description.description: (IN) Description of the plant/machinery item.
description.long-description: (IN) A textual description of the specific plant or machinery item, detailing its function or purpose.

make_model.long-description: (IN) The manufacturer and model number of the plant or machinery item.

year_of_manufacture.long-description: (IN) The calendar year in which the plant or machinery item was manufactured.

new.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the plant or machinery item is new and unused.
