second_hand.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the plant or machinery item was purchased used or second-hand.

obsolete.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the plant or machinery item is considered obsolete or outdated.

purchase_cost.long-description: (IN) The original monetary cost at which the plant or machinery item was purchased.

current_market_value.long-description: (IN) The estimated monetary value of the plant or machinery item in the current market, considering its age, condition, and depreciation.

reinstatement_value.long-description: (IN) The cost to replace the plant or machinery item with a new one of similar kind and capacity, without deduction for depreciation.

includes_installation_cost.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating whether the provided purchase cost or reinstatement value for the machinery includes expenses for its installation.

appartments.description: Indicates if the premises are primarily used as apartments.
appartments.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the primary business conducted at the premises involves operating or managing apartment buildings.

condos.description: Indicates if the premises are primarily used as condos.
condos.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the primary business conducted at the premises involves operating or managing condominium units or associations.

contractor.description: Indicates if the business operating at the premises is a contractor.
contractor.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the primary business conducted at the premises is that of a contractor (e.g., general, electrical, plumbing).

institutional.description: Indicates if the business operating at the premises is institutional (e.g., school, hospital).
institutional.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the primary business conducted at the premises is institutional, such as a school, university, or hospital.

manufacturing.description: Indicates if the business operating at the premises is manufacturing.
manufacturing.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the primary business conducted at the premises involves the manufacturing or production of goods.

office.description: Indicates if the premises are primarily used as offices.
office.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the primary business conducted at the premises is office-based services.

restaurant.description: Indicates if the business operating at the premises is a restaurant.
restaurant.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the primary business conducted at the premises is a restaurant or food service establishment.

retail.description: Indicates if the business operating at the premises is retail.
retail.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the primary business conducted at the premises involves the direct sale of goods to consumers.

service.description: Indicates if the business operating at the premises is a service provider.
service.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the primary business conducted at the premises involves providing services rather than selling goods.

wholesale.description: Indicates if the business operating at the premises is wholesale.
wholesale.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the primary business conducted at the premises involves the sale of goods in large quantities to other businesses.

others.description: Indicates if the business type is other than those listed.
others.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the primary business type at the premises is not explicitly covered by the other listed options.

manufacturer.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the premises is used for manufacturing operations.

trader_wholesale.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the premises is used for wholesale trading activities.

trader_retail.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the premises is used for retail trading activities.

hotel_hospitality.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the premises is used for hotel or hospitality services.

warehouse_cold_storage.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the premises is used as a warehouse or cold storage facility.

educational.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the premises is used for educational purposes (e.g., school, college).

healthcare.long-description: (IN) A boolean flag indicating that the premises is used for healthcare services (e.g., hospital, clinic).

business_start_date.description: Date the business started operations at this location.
business_start_date.long-description: The specific date when the insured's business began its operational activities at this particular premises.

business_description.description: Detailed description of the business operations at this location.
business_description.long-description: A comprehensive narrative explaining the nature, scope, and specific activities of the business conducted at this premises.

additional_insured.description: The party is an additional insured on the policy.
additional_insured.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the party has been added to the policy to protect their interest in relation to the insured property or operations.

breach_of_warranty.description: The party has Breach of Warranty coverage.
breach_of_warranty.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the party is protected against loss even if the insured breaches a policy condition or warranty.

co_owner.description: The party is a co-owner of the property.
co_owner.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the party shares ownership of the insured property with the primary insured.

employee_as_lessor.description: The party is an employee acting as a lessor.
employee_as_lessor.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the party is an employee of the insured who also leases property to the insured.

leaseback_owner.description: The party is an owner in a leaseback arrangement.
leaseback_owner.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the party sold the property to the insured and then leased it back, maintaining an ownership interest.

lenders_loss_payable.description: The party is a lender with a loss payable interest.
lenders_loss_payable.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the party is a lender whose financial interest in the insured property is protected in the event of a loss.

lienholder.description: The party holds a lien on the insured property.
lienholder.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the party has a legal claim against the insured property for a debt or obligation.

loss_payee.description: The party is a designated loss payee.
loss_payee.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the party is designated to receive payment for a loss under the policy, usually for property in which they have a financial interest.

mortgagee.description: The party is a mortgagee with an interest in the property.
mortgagee.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the party is a lender holding a mortgage on the insured property, protected for their financial interest.

owner.description: The party is an owner of the property (other than the primary insured).
owner.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the party is an owner of the insured property, distinct from the primary insured entity.

registrant.description: The party is the registrant of the insured item.
registrant.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the party is the official registrant of the insured item (e.g., vehicle, watercraft).

trustee.description: The party is a trustee related to the insured interest.
trustee.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that the party acts as a trustee, holding legal title to property for the benefit of another related to the insured interest.

rank.description: Rank or priority of the additional interest (e.g., 1st, 2nd).
rank.long-description: The sequential order or priority of the additional interest's claim or standing, often relevant for multiple lenders or lienholders.

certificate.description: Evidence of interest is provided by a certificate of insurance.
certificate.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that proof of the additional interest's coverage or status is documented through a certificate of insurance.

policy.description: Evidence of interest is provided by the full policy document.
policy.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that proof of the additional interest's coverage or status is documented within the main insurance policy document itself.

other.description: Evidence of interest is provided by other means.
other.long-description: A boolean flag indicating that proof of the additional interest's coverage or status is provided through a method not explicitly listed.

name.description: Name of the additional interested party.
name.long-description: The full legal name of the additional party holding an interest in the insured policy or property.

address_1.description: First line of the additional interest's address.
address_1.long-description: The primary street address line for the additional interested party's mailing or physical location.

address_2.description: Second line of the additional interest's address.
address_2.long-description: An optional secondary address line for the additional interested party's mailing or physical location.

city.description: City of the additional interest's address.
city.long-description: The city component of the additional interested party's mailing or physical address.

state.description: State of the additional interest's address.
state.long-description: The state, province, or region component of the additional interested party's mailing or physical address.

zipcode.description: Postal code of the additional interest's address.
zipcode.long-description: The postal code or ZIP code component of the additional interested party's mailing or physical address.

reference_loan_no.description: Loan or reference number associated with the additional interest.
reference_loan_no.long-description: A specific loan number, account number, or other reference identifier linking the additional interest to a financial agreement or asset.

location.description: Location associated with this additional interest.
location.long-description: The specific location (e.g., location ID or address) to which this additional interest pertains.

building.description: Building associated with this additional interest.
building.long-description: The specific building (e.g., building ID or description) at the location to which this additional interest pertains.

item_class.description: Class of item associated with this additional interest (e.g., vehicle, equipment).
item_class.long-description: The general category or class of the insured item (e.g., vehicle, machinery, inventory) to which this additional interest applies.

item_no.description: Item number associated with this additional interest.
item_no.long-description: A unique identifier or serial number for the specific insured item to which this additional interest applies.

item_description.description: Description of the item associated with this additional interest.
item_description.long-description: A brief description of the specific insured item that the additional interest is associated with.

interest_end_date.description: Date when the additional interest is no longer valid.
interest_end_date.long-description: The date on which the additional interest's claim or protection under the policy is scheduled to terminate.

interest_reason.description: Reason for including this additional interest.
interest_reason.long-description: A textual explanation detailing why this additional party has a vested interest in the insured property or policy.

lein_amount.description: Amount of the lien held by the additional interest.
lein_amount.long-description: The specific monetary value of the lien or financial claim held by the additional interested party against the insured property.

occurrence.description: (US) Coverage is provided on an Occurrence basis.
occurrence.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the Commercial General Liability (CGL) coverage is provided on an 'occurrence' basis, meaning it covers incidents that occur during the policy period, regardless of when the claim is reported.

claims_made.description: (US) Coverage is provided on a Claims-Made basis.
claims_made.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the Commercial General Liability (CGL) coverage is provided on a 'claims-made' basis, meaning it covers claims reported during the policy period, provided the incident occurred on or after the retroactive date.

extended_reporting_period_opted.description: (US) Has Extended Reporting Period (ERP) been purchased/offered for Claims-Made policy?
extended_reporting_period_opted.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether an Extended Reporting Period (ERP), or 'tail' coverage, has been purchased or is being offered for a claims-made policy, allowing claims to be reported after the policy expires for incidents that occurred during the policy period.

retro_active_date.long-description: (US) The date on or after which an occurrence must take place for coverage to apply under a claims-made Commercial General Liability (CGL) policy.

extended_reporting_period_duration_month.description: (US) Duration of the Extended Reporting Period in months.
extended_reporting_period_duration_month.long-description: (US) The number of months for which an Extended Reporting Period (ERP) provides coverage after a claims-made policy expires, if opted.

general_aggregate_limit.description: (US) Maximum amount payable for all claims during the policy period, except for Products-Completed Operations.
general_aggregate_limit.long-description: (US) The maximum dollar amount the insurer will pay for all covered losses during the policy period, excluding losses under the Products-Completed Operations Hazard.

products_completed_ops_aggregate_limit.description: (US) Maximum amount payable for all Products-Completed Operations claims during the policy period.
products_completed_ops_aggregate_limit.long-description: (US) The maximum dollar amount the insurer will pay for all damages arising out of the Products-Completed Operations Hazard during the policy period.

personal_advertising_injury_limit.description: (US) Maximum amount payable for Personal and Advertising Injury per person/organization.
personal_advertising_injury_limit.long-description: (US) The maximum dollar amount the insurer will pay for the sum of all damages arising out of personal and advertising injury sustained by any one person or organization.

each_occurrence_limit.long-description: (US) The maximum dollar amount the insurer will pay for damages arising out of any one occurrence, regardless of the number of claimants.

medical_expense_limit.description: (US) Maximum amount payable for Medical Expenses per person.
medical_expense_limit.long-description: (US) The maximum dollar amount the insurer will pay for medical expenses incurred by any one person due to bodily injury caused by an accident on the insured's premises or due to the insured's operations.

damage_to_rented_premises_limit.description: (US) Maximum amount payable for Damage to Premises Rented to You (Fire Legal Liability).
damage_to_rented_premises_limit.long-description: (US) The maximum dollar amount the insurer will pay for damages to premises rented to the insured, specifically for fire damage or other covered perils, often referred to as Fire Legal Liability.

deductible_per_occurrence.long-description: (US) The amount the insured must pay out-of-pocket for each covered occurrence before the Commercial General Liability (CGL) policy begins to pay.

self_insured_retention_per_occurrence.long-description: (US) The amount the insured must pay out-of-pocket for each covered occurrence, including defense costs, before the Commercial General Liability (CGL) policy begins to respond. This is typically higher than a deductible.

deductible_aggregate.long-description: (US) The total amount of deductibles the insured must pay for all covered losses during the policy period before the insurer covers 100% of subsequent losses, up to the policy limits.

self_insured_retention_aggregate.long-description: (US) The total amount of Self-Insured Retention (SIR) the insured must pay for all covered losses during the policy period before the insurer's liability begins, typically including defense costs.

location_id.description: (US) Reference to Location ID for this exposure.
location_id.long-description: (US) A reference to the unique identifier of the specific location associated with this general liability exposure.

classification_code.description: (US) ISO Commercial General Liability classification code.
classification_code.long-description: (US) The specific ISO (Insurance Services Office) classification code assigned to the insured's operations, used for rating general liability exposures.

description.description: (US) Description of operations for this classification.
description.long-description: (US) A detailed textual description of the specific business operations or activities that correspond to the given CGL classification code.

sales.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the general liability premium is calculated based on the insured's gross sales revenue.

payroll.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the general liability premium is calculated based on the insured's total payroll.

area_sq_ft.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the general liability premium is calculated based on the square footage of the insured premises.

units.description: (US) Exposure basis is Units (per unit produced/sold).
units.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the general liability premium is calculated based on the number of units produced, sold, or serviced.

other.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating that the general liability premium is calculated based on an exposure basis not explicitly listed.

exposure_amount.description: (US) Amount of exposure (e.g., total sales, payroll, sq ft).
exposure_amount.long-description: (US) The numerical value corresponding to the chosen exposure basis, such as total annual sales in currency, total annual payroll in currency, or total square footage.

rate.description: (US) Rate applied per unit of exposure.
rate.long-description: (US) The per-unit rate applied to the exposure amount to calculate the general liability premium (e.g., per $1,000 of sales or payroll, per 100 sq ft).

products_completed_operations_sales.description: (US) Total annual sales for Products-Completed Operations exposure.
products_completed_operations_sales.long-description: (US) The total annual gross sales revenue specifically related to products manufactured, sold, handled, or distributed by the insured, or operations completed by or for the insured, used as an exposure basis for Products-Completed Operations Liability.

contractual_liability_incl.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether the Commercial General Liability (CGL) policy includes coverage for liability assumed by the insured under a contract or agreement.

xcu_exposure.description: (US) Is there Explosion, Collapse, or Underground (XCU) exposure?
xcu_exposure.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether the insured has exposures related to explosion, collapse, or underground hazards, which are often specifically excluded or require special handling under CGL policies.

liquor_liability_exposure.description: (US) Does the insured have Liquor Liability exposure?
liquor_liability_exposure.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether the insured's operations involve the manufacturing, distributing, selling, serving, or furnishing of alcoholic beverages, which can create Liquor Liability exposure.

employee_benefits_liability.description: (US) Is Employee Benefits Liability coverage included?
employee_benefits_liability.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether coverage for errors or omissions in the administration of the insured's employee benefits programs (e.g., health, life, pension plans) is included.

mobile_equipment_coverage.description: (US) Is coverage provided for mobile equipment?
mobile_equipment_coverage.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether the Commercial General Liability (CGL) policy extends coverage to liability arising from the ownership, maintenance, or use of mobile equipment.

pollution_exclusion_applicable.description: (US) Is a total pollution exclusion applicable?
pollution_exclusion_applicable.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether a total pollution exclusion endorsement is attached to the policy, significantly limiting or removing coverage for pollution-related liability.

opted.description: (US) Does the applicant use subcontractors (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: (US) A Y/N indicator whether the insured utilizes independent contractors (subcontractors) for any part of their operations.

cost_of_subcontractors.long-description: (US) The total monetary amount paid annually to all subcontractors by the insured.

certificates_obtained_from_subcontractor.description: (US) Are Certificates of Insurance obtained from all subcontractors?
certificates_obtained_from_subcontractor.long-description: (US) A boolean flag indicating whether the insured consistently obtains Certificates of Insurance from all subcontractors, verifying their own liability coverage.

opted.description: (US) Is there any prior or pending litigation against the applicant (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: (US) A Y/N indicator whether the applicant has any lawsuits or legal actions that were initiated before the current policy period or are still ongoing.

litigation_desc.description: (US) Description of prior or pending litigation.
litigation_desc.long-description: (US) A detailed explanation of any prior or pending litigation, including the nature of the claim, parties involved, and current status.

opted.description: (US) Does the applicant engage in any unusual operations not typical for their business (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: (US) A Y/N indicator whether the insured performs any activities or operations that are outside the normal scope of their declared business type and could present unique liability risks.

unusual_operations_desc.long-description: (US) A detailed explanation of any unusual operations, providing context for underwriting assessment.

other_liability_coverages_description.description: (US) Description of any other General Liability coverages not explicitly listed.
other_liability_coverages_description.long-description: (US) An open text field to specify any additional or unique general liability coverages or endorsements that are not categorized by the predefined options.

opted.description: Indicates if the applicant is a subsidiary of another company (Y/N).
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the applying entity is controlled by or owned by a larger parent company.

parent_company.long-description: The full legal name of the controlling entity if the applicant is a subsidiary.

relationship.description: Description of the relationship with the parent company.
relationship.long-description: A textual explanation of the legal and operational connection between the applicant and its parent company (e.g., 'wholly owned', 'majority owned').

ownership_percent.description: Percentage of ownership by the parent company.
ownership_percent.long-description: The percentage of the applicant's ownership stake held by the parent company.

opted.description: Indicates if the applicant has any subsidiaries (Y/N).
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the applicant entity controls or owns other companies.

subsidiary_name.long-description: The full legal name of a company owned or controlled by the applicant.

relationship.description: Description of the relationship with the subsidiary.
relationship.long-description: A textual explanation of the legal and operational connection between the applicant and its subsidiary (e.g., 'wholly owned', 'majority owned').

ownership_percent.description: Percentage of ownership of the subsidiary by the applicant.
ownership_percent.long-description: The percentage of the subsidiary's ownership stake held by the applicant company.

opted.description: Indicates if a formal safety program is in place (Y/N).
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the insured has implemented a structured program to promote workplace safety and prevent accidents.

manual_safety.description: Does the program include a written safety manual?
manual_safety.long-description: A boolean flag indicating if the safety program includes a documented, written manual outlining safety policies and procedures.

safety_position.description: Is there a designated safety officer or position?
safety_position.long-description: A boolean flag indicating if the insured has a specific individual or role dedicated to overseeing and managing safety initiatives.

monthly_meetings.long-description: A boolean flag indicating if regular (e.g., monthly) meetings are held to discuss safety topics, address concerns, and provide training.

osha.description: Does the program comply with OSHA standards (USA)?
osha.long-description: A boolean flag indicating whether the safety program adheres to the occupational safety and health standards set forth by OSHA in the USA.

other.description: Are there other safety program features not listed?
other.long-description: A boolean flag indicating the presence of additional safety program features not explicitly detailed in the other options.

opted.description: Are flammable materials used or stored on premises (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether any materials susceptible to rapid combustion or ignition are present at the insured premises.

flammable_exposure.description: Description of flammable materials and their storage/use.
flammable_exposure.long-description: A detailed explanation of the types of flammable materials, the quantities involved, and how they are stored or used at the premises.

opted.description: Does the applicant have other insurance policies (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the insured holds any other active insurance policies for different lines of business or with other carriers.

line_of_business.description: Line of business for the other policy (e.g., Auto, GL).
line_of_business.long-description: The specific type of coverage (e.g., Commercial Auto, General Liability) provided by the other insurance policy.

policy_no.description: Policy number of the other insurance policy.
policy_no.long-description: The unique identification number assigned to the other insurance policy.

opted.description: Has any insurance coverage ever been declined, cancelled, or non-renewed (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the applicant has previously faced a situation where an insurance policy was refused, terminated, or not offered for renewal.

non_payment.description: Was the denial due to non-payment of premium?
non_payment.long-description: A boolean flag indicating if the previous denial of coverage was specifically caused by the insured's failure to pay premiums.

non_renewal.description: Was the denial a non-renewal by an insurer?
non_renewal.long-description: A boolean flag indicating if the previous denial of coverage was an insurer's decision not to offer renewal terms for an existing policy.

agent_refused.description: Was the denial due to an agent refusing to place coverage?
agent_refused.long-description: A boolean flag indicating if the previous denial of coverage resulted from an Ninsurance agent or broker refusing to submit or place the application.

underwriter_refused.description: Was the denial due to an underwriter refusing to offer terms?
underwriter_refused.long-description: A boolean flag indicating if the previous denial of coverage was due to an underwriter's decision not to provide insurance terms after risk assessment.

condition_corrected.description: Have the conditions that led to the denial been corrected?
condition_corrected.long-description: A boolean flag indicating if any underlying issues or risks that led to the previous denial of coverage have since been rectified or improved.

opted.description: Have there been any claims or allegations of sexual abuse or molestation (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the insured or its representatives have been subject to any claims, lawsuits, or allegations related to sexual abuse or molestation.

description.description: Description of any sexual abuse or molestation claims/allegations.
description.long-description: A textual explanation providing details about any past claims or allegations of sexual abuse or molestation, including dates, outcomes, and current status.

opted.description: Has the applicant or any principal ever been criminally indicted or convicted (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the applicant entity or any of its key individuals (principals) have ever been formally accused (indicted) or found guilty (convicted) of a criminal offense.

description.description: Description of any criminal indictments or convictions.
description.long-description: A textual explanation providing details about any criminal indictments or convictions, including dates, charges, and outcomes.

opted.description: Have there been any fire code violations in the past (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the insured premises has ever been found in violation of local or national fire safety codes.

date.description: Date of the fire code violation.
date.long-description: The date on which the fire code violation was observed or cited.

description.description: Description of the fire code violation.
description.long-description: A textual explanation detailing the specific fire code violation, its nature, and severity.

resolution.description: Description of how the violation was resolved.
resolution.long-description: A textual explanation describing the actions taken to rectify the fire code violation.

resolved_on.description: Date the fire code violation was resolved.
resolved_on.long-description: The date on which the fire code violation was officially addressed and deemed resolved.

opted.description: Has the applicant or any principal ever been subject to foreclosure proceedings (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the applicant or any key individual has ever had property repossessed by a lender due to failure to make mortgage payments.

date.long-description: The date when the foreclosure proceeding or event took place.

description.description: Description of the foreclosure event.
description.long-description: A textual explanation detailing the circumstances and nature of the foreclosure event.

resolution.description: Description of how the foreclosure was resolved.
resolution.long-description: A textual explanation describing the outcome or resolution of the foreclosure proceedings.

resolved_on.long-description: The date on which the foreclosure issue was officially concluded or resolved.

opted.description: Are there any outstanding liens against the applicant's property or assets (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether there are any current legal claims (liens) held by others against the applicant's property or assets as security for a debt.

date.long-description: The date on which the lien was legally recorded or became effective.

description.description: Description of the lien.
description.long-description: A textual explanation detailing the type of lien (e.g., tax lien, mechanic's lien) and the debt it secures.

resolution.description: Description of how the lien was resolved.
resolution.long-description: A textual explanation describing the actions taken to satisfy or remove the lien.

resolved_on.long-description: The date on which the lien was officially satisfied or removed from the property/asset.

opted.description: Is the property insured under a trust (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the ownership of the insured property is legally held within a trust arrangement.

trust_name.long-description: The full legal name of the trust that owns or holds the insured property.

opted.description: Does the applicant own or operate any other businesses not covered by this application (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the applicant has any other business ventures or operations that are not intended to be covered by the current insurance application.

description.description: Description of other businesses not covered.
description.long-description: A textual explanation detailing the nature and scope of any other businesses owned or operated by the applicant that are outside the scope of this insurance application.

opted.description: Does the applicant own or operate drones (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the applicant directly owns or operates unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) for business purposes.

description.description: Description of drone ownership/operation activities.
description.long-description: A textual explanation detailing the type of drones, their purpose of use, and frequency of operation if the applicant owns or operates them.

opted.description: Does the applicant hire others to operate drones (Y/N)?
opted.long-description: A Y/N indicator whether the applicant contracts third-party individuals or companies to operate drones on their behalf.

description.description: Description of hiring practices for drone operators.
description.long-description: A textual explanation detailing the nature of services for which drone operators are hired, frequency, and any vetting procedures if the applicant hires others.

remarks.description: Any additional remarks or information relevant to underwriting.
remarks.long-description: An open text field for any supplementary comments, explanations, or additional information that the applicant believes is relevant for the underwriter's consideration.

applicant_signature_date.description: Date the applicant signed the application.
applicant_signature_date.long-description: The date on which the primary insured or their authorized representative affixed their signature to the insurance application.

producer_name.description: Name of the producer who signed the application.
producer_name.long-description: The full name of the insurance agent or broker who signed the application, confirming its submission.

producer_state_license_no.description: State license number of the producer.
producer_state_license_no.long-description: The license number of the producer within the specific state or jurisdiction where they are authorized to conduct insurance business.

national_producer_number.long-description: The National Producer Number (NPN) is a unique identification number assigned to licensed insurance producers in the United States by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC). It is a mandatory requirement in certain states like Florida.

id.description: Unique identifier for this blanket coverage entry.
id.long-description: A unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to differentiate individual blanket coverage schedules or entries.

blanket_no.long-description: (US) A specific alphanumeric identification number assigned to a blanket coverage item, allowing one amount of insurance to cover multiple items or locations.

description.description: (US) The description of the blanket cover
description.long-description: (US) A brief textual description of what the blanket coverage applies to (e.g., 'All Buildings', 'Business Personal Property at all locations').

limit_amount.description: Total limit of insurance for this blanket coverage.
limit_amount.long-description: The maximum monetary amount that will be paid for losses under this specific blanket coverage, regardless of the number of items or locations covered.

loc_nos_covered.description: (US) comma-separated list of location numbers covered under this blanket
loc_nos_covered.long-description: (US) A string containing a comma-separated list of location identifiers that are encompassed by this blanket insurance coverage.

blanket_type.description: Type of blanket coverage (e.g., Property, Contents).
blanket_type.long-description: The category or type of assets that are covered under this blanket policy, such as 'Building', 'Business Personal Property', 'Stock', or a combination.
